No DOM elements, Recharts, Leaflet, framer-motion, browser globals, or old web UI components are imported. Gates run from apps/native: `npm run typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `npm run lint -- --quiet` (eslint), `npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles` (jest).
